page_type: Office of Faculty Advancement faculty TDL/FML policy page (rev. Oct 2019) + HR parental leave page
note: There is no dedicated faculty paid parental leave: faculty who give birth get paid recovery leave (usually 6-8 weeks) under temporary disability leave (GR X), and the 4-week paid parental leave covers staff only; non-tenured faculty taking 6+ weeks of FML may request a 26-week probationary extension (OFA page).

page_type: GT HR benefits page (implements USG/state policy) + GT Faculty Handbook section 3.3.5 Tenure
note: Paid leave is the USG-wide benefit for all employees (up to 240 hours, about 6 weeks, since 1 Jul 2024, plus 120 hours maternal birth leave for births from 1 Jul 2026); the Faculty Handbook 3.3.5 allows a probationary extension of 1 year per event (max 2) for childbirth or adoption, on request.

page_type: UC/AAUP collective bargaining agreement 2025-2028 (Article 19.5 Paid Parental Leave; Article 19.2 Child-Rearing Leave)
note: Article 19.5 gives full release from duties for up to 6 continuous weeks plus release from course teaching for that semester; no tenure-clock extension is tied to PPL, only unpaid child-rearing leave of 1+ year can be excluded from the appointment term (19.2.3); covers AAUP bargaining-unit faculty only, and the provost's public PPL page now points to the intranet.

page_type: HR paid parental leave page + FSU BOT/UFF collective bargaining agreement 2025-2028 (Art. 17.7 Parental Leaves; Art. 15 Extension of Tenure-Earning Period)
note: Faculty get up to 6 months of paid parental leave (one or two qualifying events) with relief from teaching for one semester per event; CBA Art. 15 allows a 1-year tenure extension on request for childbirth or adoption.

page_type: Faculty Handbook 2026-2027, Chapter 3 Part One Article II Section E (Faculty Paid Parental Leave Policy)
note: Primary caregivers get up to 16 weeks (equivalent to a semester) at 100% pay and secondary caregivers 3 weeks, with relief from all duties; a pre-tenure extension may be requested (Ch. 3 Part One Art. I G.4-7).

page_type: University policy page (Faculty Parental Leave policy, effective 1 Jan 2002)
note: Primary-caregiver regular faculty get a one-semester paid leave (stated as a semester, not weeks), and untenured tenure-track faculty may exclude one year from the tenure clock.

page_type: ACD 710 Parental Leave with Pay (Academic Affairs Policy Manual, revised 6/1/2024) + Academic Personnel parental leave page
note: 12 weeks at 100% pay (18 weeks combined if both parents are ASU employees), the eligibility wait is waived for tenured and tenure-eligible faculty, alternate duties for the semester, and leave counts as good cause for a probationary extension under ACD 506-03.

page_type: Faculty Handbook Chapter 4 (Temporary Parental Leaves; Tenure Clock Relief) + Provost Faculty Affairs leave page
note: Regular-rank faculty get a one-semester paid parental leave (up to 3 months in Medicine and Nursing) and non-regular-rank faculty 6 paid weeks, with an automatic 1-year tenure clock extension for tenure-track faculty.

page_type: Standard Practice Guide policies (201.30-6 paid leave, 201.93 modified duties, 201.92 tenure clock) + Provost family-friendly summary page
note: Six weeks of paid childbirth leave plus six weeks of paid parental leave (SPG 201.30-6, updated Feb 2025); faculty may take one term of modified duties without teaching in place of the 6-week parental leave (SPG 201.93); one year may be excluded from the tenure clock per birth or adoption, max two (SPG 201.92).

page_type: Permanent Memorandum PM-20 Employee Leave (rev. 19 Mar 2024) + Academic Affairs tenure clock extension page + PS-36-T tenure policy (rev. 10 Feb 2025)
note: PM-20 gives all eligible leave-earning employees up to 240 hours (6 weeks) of paid parental leave for events on or after 1 Jan 2024, without naming faculty; tenure clock extension (normally 1 year, on request) is under PS-36-T, with childbirth or adoption listed as qualifying reasons.
